necessary_bound_scope.source: Manuscript Theorem3 Eq13, AppendixD Theorem15 Eq70 and discussion on PDF page21
necessary_bound_scope.reference_class: Single gate with L=1; the same question-count lower bound applies to a class allowing arbitrary within-question dependence through identical repetitions
necessary_bound_scope.conditional_independent_L3: A repeated L=1 value in an L=3 conditional-independent row is only a reference to the larger arbitrary-dependence class. It is not asserted as a necessary bound for this stricter simulated subclass.
necessary_bound_scope.prerequisites: Positive gain Delta in (0,rho/2], harmful-selection error at most delta under the negative distribution and detection probability at least1-delta under the positive distribution

sufficient_bound_scope: Theorem3/15 gives sufficient question counts for its specified empirical-Bernstein certificate under the stated population assumptions. These are not universal necessary sample sizes for every procedure.
